question: What is gen2's bridge -- its delivered surface minus OUR reconstructed gen2 surface -- at the checkpoints whose clouds we already hold?

inputs.role: gen2's own 2021 USGS checkpoints; usgs_*_z_m is the DELIVERED surface elevation at the mark
gen2 3DEP cloud cropped about one checkpoint; class 2 is its vendor ground
gen2 3DEP cloud cropped about one checkpoint; class 2 is its vendor ground
gen2 3DEP cloud cropped about one checkpoint; class 2 is its vendor ground

params.name: point_types
params.why: the validation at 24 elbaext points gives median local-grid -0.04 mm at ZERO canopy cover and -126.07 mm in the steepest slope quartile, so the producer is trusted only on the open low-slope ground NVA marks sit on

params.name: surface
params.why: which of gen2's four delivered surfaces the bridge is measured against; it must match the surface whose datum constant it will be added to

params.name: radii_m
params.why: radius of the order-2 fit at the mark; swept, and a radius that cannot be filled with 6 cells is reported, never dropped

params.name: ground_class
params.why: gen2's vendor ground; its delivered classification carries only 1 and 2

params.name: swath_alignment
params.why: gen2 is the reference epoch and no corrections file on disk carries a gen2 swath; measured adjacent-pair ties are |k| <= 4.8 mm

params.name: geoid_term
params.why: gen2 IS the frame; its control and its cloud are both NAVD88(GEOID18)

columns.type: USGS accuracy class, unitless: NVA non-vegetated, VVA vegetated
columns.n_ground: class-2 gen2 returns in the crop, count
columns.delivered_z_m: the delivered surface elevation at the mark, m
columns.ours_z_m: our reconstructed gen2 surface at the mark, m; same frame
columns.bridge_mm: z_delivered - z_ours, mm; ADD to a delivered-surface constant to carry it onto our surface
columns.radius_spread_mm: max - min of bridge_mm over the radii that could be fitted, mm

headline: gen2 bridge n=4 mean +77.29 mm
